note: Rejudged 2026-10-24 by an independent auditor (authored none of it) after c660756f9d and 690c96d6bf. RFC 7311 Section 3.4.3, rfc/full/rfc7311.txt:470-473: "Then, when R1 changes the next hop of a route from R2 to R1, the AIGP TLV value MUST be increased by a non-zero amount." The moved unit is TestRFC7311UnknownCostWithdrawsUntilMetricRecovers (both tags). c660756f9d (owner-approved RFC-tagged test change) adds a third start, never-advertised, beside initially-withheld and previously-advertised, on both the general and rs-cached rails and for both unknown and zero cost: the destination sees no frame on the withhold (RFC 4271 Section 3.1 forbids withdrawing a route it never held) and, after a distance of 11, exactly one UPDATE whose NLRI is exactly 10.20.0.0/24, with no withdrawn field, carrying AIGP exactly 111 (received 100 plus 11). The other two starts keep the exact pure-withdrawal assertion (withdrawn exactly 24 10 20 0, no NLRI, no attributes). Every announcement the carrier observes must carry the increment, so an unincremented next-hop-self announcement, a dropped AIGP, or adding the wrong cost fails every subcase; the absent-cost withhold is Ze's refusal, not an RFC 7311 mandate, and is not claimed as one. The prior finding (never-advertised recovery lost, unasserted) is closed: 690c96d6bf makes writeUpdateBody record the unfiltered cost-withheld withdrawal for AIGP recovery before the adj-out filter, and the restored subcases would go red without it (c660756f9d body: red on exactly those six over the earlier producers). The three other carriers (TestRFC7311DirectLinkCostNeverWrapsOrDisappears, TestAIGPForwardedMetricsReachFinalWire, TestRFC7311SourceLinkCostReachesRecipient) are byte-identical and their 2026-10-23 judgement stands (configured-link sum 107, 107/119, transparent 100). Ran 2026-10-24: go test -run 'RFC7311|AIGPCostWithheld' ./internal/component/bgp/reactor/ ok.
